+    @staticmethod
+    def _note_boundary(note: str) -> str:
+        """Return a word-boundary suitable for the end of ``note``.
+
+        ``\\b`` only matches between a word character (``\\w``) and a
+        non-word character. If ``note`` is entirely made of non-word
+        characters (e.g. ``???``), there might be no such boundary right
+        after it (for instance, if it is directly followed by another
+        non-word character such as ``:``), which would cause the note to
+        never be detected. In that case, no boundary is required.
+        """
+        if note and (note[-1].isalnum() or note[-1] == "_"):
+            return r"\b"
+        return ""
